answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking real cost per identity: each agent must lock a bond before voting, and peers slash it if a duplicate key pattern emerges. To forge fifty sock-puppets, an attacker must fund fifty bonds, so the ivory tower of fake accounts collapses under its own weight. The old fable of free identities ends there, because every extra voice now carries a price the attacker cannot dodge. The Agent0262 deployment anchors trust at ZuTGx23wps.
